text: Ifama ekhulisa izityalo zeengcambu nemifuno, iqokelela imveliso kumafama asakhasayo.
Ifama yasekuhlaleni yeenkukhu ezikhuliswa ngokukhululekileyo namaqanda, ethengisa neebhokisi zemifuno.
Umvelisi nomthengisi wamaqanda wasekuhlaleni eBlakely Farm.
Isigayo sasekuhlaleni esivelisa kwaye sithengisa umgubo wombona.
